name: Going Concern Analysis
title: Going Concern Analysis
answer: Going concern analysis is the work of judging whether a company can meet its obligations for at least the next twelve months, and it sits inside continuous audit and assurance because the judgement now has to be refreshed between reporting dates rather than once a year. In an AI context the scope covers the entity itself and the models, vendors and data sources it depends on, since a failed model provider or a withdrawn dataset can change the picture quickly. It also covers the disclosures a board makes about that judgement, which is where most of the audit risk concentrates.

crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Going concern analysis is the work of judging whether a company can meet its obligations for at least the next twelve months, and it sits inside continuous audit and assurance because the judgement now has to be refreshed between reporting dates rather than once a year. In an AI context the scope covers the entity itself and the models, vendors and data sources it depends on, since a failed model provider or a withdrawn dataset can change the picture quickly. It also covers the disclosures a board makes about that judgement, which is where most of the audit risk concentrates.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: The work runs on the same ledgers, ERP extracts and bank feeds that feed the audit file, plus a growing set of external signals such as filings, news and credit data. Continuous assurance setups pull these on a schedule and hold them in a monitored data layer, so the evidence behind a going concern conclusion is dated and traceable rather than assembled at year end. Model monitoring sits alongside, because a forecast that quietly degrades is worse than no forecast at all.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: Analysts start from cash flow forecasts, covenant schedules and the maturity profile of debt, then test the assumptions behind them with sensitivity and scenario analysis. Machine learning is used mainly to flag anomalies, score deterioration risk and compare an entity against peers, while the conclusion itself stays with a person who can weigh management plans and mitigating actions. The output is a documented judgement with the evidence, assumptions and dissent recorded, not a single number.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Responsibility sits with the board and the auditor, and the standards that govern the judgement are accounting and auditing standards rather than anything specific to AI. Where models contribute, firms need model documentation, validation records, access controls and a clear audit trail from input to conclusion, and the same evidence has to survive regulatory review. Data used in the analysis carries its own provenance and licensing constraints, and personal or confidential financial data has to stay within the agreed boundary. Nothing here is legal, financial or investment advice.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The direction of travel is toward continuous going concern monitoring, where covenant, cash and counterparty signals are watched through the period and escalate automatically when thresholds are crossed. That shifts the auditor from reconstructing a judgement after the fact to testing a live process, which raises new questions about how much of the conclusion can be automated and how it is evidenced. Expect more attention to model risk in the forecast itself, and to whether the disclosures keep pace with how quickly the underlying position can change.
